offsetNote: char = Python str (unicode code point) index, byte = UTF-8 byte index into index.html. They differ after offset ~13200 because the file contains multi-byte chars (box-drawing comments, bullets). Ranges are [start, end) and cover the full <svg ...>...</svg> element. Strip ' data-astro-cid-XXXX' attributes after extracting. Extraction: python3 -c "s=open('index.html',encoding='utf-8').read(); print(s[START:END])"
